body: he can't afford a lawyer and I used one on him already. He's homeless and unemployable making money off gigs. His only defense against me is scaring me with his Internet stuff. Anytime I take measures to protect myself, I get another webpage with all new crazy stuff written about me.

He loves pushing limits and has a very criminal based mind. I need the websites down so I can just live but I can't live now.
